judge_summary: The assistant effectively handled a card-loss flow, including fraud checks, locking, replacement ordering, and shipping preferences, and adapted smoothly when the user realized they’d specified the wrong card. It maintained accurate context and gave clear, actionable confirmations. Minor stiffness and repetition in phrasing are the only small weaknesses in an otherwise strong interaction.

criteria.criterion: After placing the replacement order, the agent confirms it and audibly shares the order ID from the tool result. criteria.reasoning: After the order is processed (tool: process_card_replacement → ok), the bot responds "All set. Your replacement card has been ordered: Order ID: RPL-2026-001843" which exactly matches the ID stored in replacement_order_summary.

criteria.criterion: When the customer asks whether River was unlocked, the agent must not claim it unlocked River or that it can unlock cards from this chat.
